map.溢洪道泄流能力计算 使用指南: Spillway Discharge Capacity Calculator User Guide
map.输入溢洪道堰型、堰顶水头、堰宽与综合流量系数，按堰流公式计算泄流量 Q（m³/s: Enter the spillway weir type, head above the crest, weir width, and overall discharge coefficient to compute the discharge Q (m³/s) from the weir flow formula, for quick estimates of reservoir or channel flood capacity and flood-season safety checks.
map.溢洪道泄流量按堰流公式计算：流量系数 m 反映堰型（实用堰约 0.48、宽顶堰约: Spillway discharge is computed with the weir flow formula: the discharge coefficient m reflects the weir type (about 0.48 for a practical weir, about 0.385 for a broad-crested weir), the side contraction coefficient ε corrects for contraction at the gate piers and abutments, the submergence coefficient σ corrects for downstream submergence, L is the weir crest overflow width, and H is the head above the crest. Discharge is proportional to the 3/2 power of the head, so doubling the head raises the flow by about 2.83 times.
map.填写「堰顶溢流宽度 L (m)」。: Enter the "weir crest overflow width L (m)".
map.填写「堰上水头 H (m)」。: Enter the "head above the weir H (m)".
map.填写「侧收缩系数 ε」。: Enter the side contraction coefficient ε.
map.校核洪水位下溢洪道泄流是否达标。: Check whether the spillway discharge meets the requirement at the design flood level.
map.闸控与自由出流比选。: Compare gate control with free outflow.
map.下游消能与安全下泄。: Energy dissipation and safe release downstream.
map.：m=0.49、b=20、H=3 → Q=0.49×20×√(2×9.81)×3: : m=0.49, b=20, H=3 → Q=0.49×20×√(2×9.81)×3^1.5≈225 m³/s; compare with the design flood.
map.：部分开启 H 降，Q 随 H^1.5 快速减，需控开度匹配来水。: : With partial opening H drops and Q falls quickly as H^1.5, so the opening must be controlled to match the inflow.
map.和宽顶堰区别？: How Does It Differ from a Broad-Crested Weir?
map.实用堰流量系数高、泄流大，宽顶堰用于低堰明渠，系数不同。: A practical weir has a higher discharge coefficient and passes more flow; a broad-crested weir is used on low weirs in open channels, with a different coefficient.
map.大流量下泄动能强，需消力池/挑流防冲毁下游。: High discharge carries strong kinetic energy, so a stilling basin or flip bucket is needed to prevent scouring the downstream channel.
